entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: gemma-reader
entries.description: LM Studio chat config, google/gemma-4-e4b by default
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: lm-studio-default
entries.description: LM Studio chat config, openai/gpt-oss-120b by default
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: openai-default
entries.description: OpenAI chat config, gpt-5.4-mini by default
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: openai-embeddings
entries.description: OpenAI embedding config, text-embedding-3-small by default
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: speech-to-text
entries.description: OpenAI speech-to-text config, whisper-1 by default
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: release-notes-haiku
entries.description: Claude Haiku at a low temperature — steady, short writing for release notes
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: answer-relevance-checker
entries.description: Reviews an agent's draft answer for relevance to the user's question. Returns the unchanged answer, a corrected version, or a BLOCK: line.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: code-analyst
entries.description: Read-only deep-analysis sub-agent. Given specific files or a subsystem, reads the code and explains how it works, traces a flow, or answers a precise technical question with evidence (file:line citations). Call via run_agent when you need understanding, not just location.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: coding-assistant
entries.description: Works in a code project: finds its way around with grep and glob, reads files with line numbers, makes targeted edits with file_edit, and runs the build and tests with bash. Choose the project with the chat's folder button first.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: conversation-summarizer
entries.description: Summarizes older conversation turns for working-memory compression
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: default-chat
entries.description: The agent a chat runs on when you did not start it from one. Runs commands, reads files and documents, and delegates web research and file hunting to two specialists.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: document-analyst
entries.description: Sub-agent for long documents (PDF, Word). Given a document path and a question, uses outline/grep/page-range tools to answer with exact page citations — without blowing context on the full text. Call via run_agent.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: explorer
entries.description: Read-only exploration sub-agent. Sweeps the filesystem/codebase to locate files, directories and naming conventions and reports the conclusion (paths + brief why), not full file dumps. Call via run_agent for broad 'where is / which files' searches.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: file-finder
entries.description: Sub-agent that locates files on the user's filesystem by name, type or location hint. Call via run_agent.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: planner
entries.description: Orchestrator agent that decomposes a large task into sub-tasks, delegates each to a specialized sub-agent via run_agent, verifies the results and synthesizes a final answer.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: Poet
entries.description: A creative poet who crafts beautiful poems on any topic
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: research-lead
entries.description: Research orchestrator. Breaks a research question into independent sub-topics, dispatches them to web-researcher IN PARALLEL via run_agents, fact-checks the findings with the verifier, and answers with a single cited Markdown report. Demo-friendly planner.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: Summarizer
entries.description: Writes concise Markdown summaries of any text it is given
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: title-generator
entries.description: Generates a short title for a conversation from the first user message
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: tool-summarizer
entries.description: Compresses large tool results after the first LLM turn
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: url-reader
entries.description: Reads ONE web page and answers a specific question about it, returning only the relevant excerpts. Call via run_agent to keep a large page out of the caller's context.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: verifier
entries.description: Adversarial verification sub-agent. Given a claim plus the evidence/paths/URLs it rests on, tries to REFUTE it and returns a verdict (confirmed / refuted / uncertain) with reasons. Call via run_agent before trusting an important sub-result.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: web-researcher
entries.description: Sub-agent that performs focused web research and returns structured findings. Call via run_agent.
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: changelog-writer
entries.description: Turns a list of commits into changelog lines a user can decide an upgrade on
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: release-announcer
entries.description: Writes a short release announcement for a chat channel or blog from changelog lines
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: approval
entries.description: Pauses for a human decision and records it — the halt-and-resume example
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: classify-numbers
entries.description: Labels each number of a list big or small — a loop with a condition
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: file-ingestion
entries.description: Splits a document (Word, PDF, Markdown) into sections and upserts them into a vector store
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: form-demo
entries.description: Asks for input through a form step and records the answer
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: hello
entries.description: Greets a name — the smallest workflow there is
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: pipeline
entries.description: Iterates over a list of items — a minimal loop
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: word-to-markdown
entries.description: Converts a Word document into one Markdown file per section, each with a summary written by the Summarizer agent
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: wordreport-gen
entries.description: Generates a Word report from a template: pick the sections, ingest the source documents, draft each section from them
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: release-notes
entries.description: From the commits of a release to a changelog and an announcement, one agent after the other
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: Mindconnect defaults
entries.description: Everything a fresh Mindconnect installation ships with: every LLM config, agent and workflow
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: Runtime utilities
entries.description: The helper agents the runtime calls by name: chat titles, memory compression, tool-result summaries, answer review
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: Document kit
entries.description: Read long documents, ingest them into a knowledge store, convert Word to Markdown and generate reports from a template
entries.author: mindconnect

entries.name: Release notes kit
entries.description: From a list of commits to a changelog and a release announcement: two agents, the workflow that runs them in turn, and the model they share
entries.author: mindconnect
